title: Senior Quality Test Engineer II
jobDescription:
Senior Quality Test Engineer II – Salesforce + AI Do you enjoy driving the quality strategy for complex software systems? About our Team:- Digital Business Solutions (DBS) delivers innovation and solves customer and business problems by leveraging the power of technology, data, and — increasingly — AI. Within DBS, the AI Innovation team focuses specifically on identifying and delivering agentic and generative AI capabilities across our Salesforce ecosystem and adjacent platforms. We partner with sales teams and Elsevier colleagues to drive intelligent automation, frictionless personalized experiences, and streamlined processes that support cost optimization and growth. We provide the expertise to understand business challenges and translate them into practical, responsible AI-enabled solutions. About the

ROLE:
-
This position performs complex quality engineering and test design assignments for AI-driven and agentic solutions built on our Salesforce platform (2,000+ users) and adjacent integrated systems (Oracle Sales Cloud Incentive Comp, Gainsight, Monday.com, and others). This role owns the quality strategy for both traditional deterministic Salesforce functionality (Apex, LWC, Flow, integrations) and non-deterministic AI/agentic capabilities (Agentforce agents, prompt-driven automations, generative AI features), where "correctness" must be evaluated differently than in conventional software. This position mentors more-junior QA engineers, partners closely with developers and business analysts to shape testable requirements, and represents quality and responsible-AI considerations throughout the SDLC — from design through production monitoring.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- 5+ years of Software Quality Engineering / Test Engineering experience, with 2+ years testing enterprise Salesforce implementations BS Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience required Experience testing AI/ML-driven, LLM-powered, or generative AI features strongly preferred Salesforce certifications (Platform App Builder, and/or AI Associate/AI Specialist) a plus Experience in regulated, audited, or compliance-driven release environments a plus Interface with developers, business analysts, and product owners to finalize testable requirements and acceptance criteria for both deterministic and AI-driven features Write and review detailed test plans, test cases, and evaluation frameworks for complex system components, including AI agents, automations, and generative AI features Design and maintain evaluation suites (golden datasets, regression benchmarks, output-quality rubrics) for agentic and generative AI capabilities where traditional pass/fail testing doesn't apply Execute and automate functional, regression, integration, and performance testing across the Salesforce platform and adjacent systems (Oracle Incentive Comp, Gainsight, Monday.com) Identify, document, and drive resolution of complex defects, including subtle AI behavior issues (hallucination, drift, bias, inconsistent outputs) Partner with developers to shift quality left — reviewing designs, prompts, and agent configurations before build, not just after Establish and evangelize quality and responsible-AI standards across the squad, including guardrails for reviewing and validating AI-generated code and AI-generated outputs before production release Support release management, packaging, and compliance/audit requirements with appropriate test evidence and traceability Monitor production AI features for quality drift and performance degradation, and define escalation paths when thresholds are breached Train and mentor less-senior QA engineers on Salesforce testing methodologies, automation frameworks, and AI/agentic testing practices Keep abreast of new Salesforce platform releases, Agent force/AI feature developments, and emerging tools and techniques in AI quality assurance All other duties as assigned Requirements:- Advanced knowledge of software quality methodologies (Agile/Scrum, risk-based testing, shift-left testing) as applied to Salesforce release cycles and org governance Strong proficiency in Salesforce test automation: Apex unit/integration testing, LWC Jest testing, UI automation frameworks (e.g., Provar, Selenium, Playwright) for Salesforce Strong understanding of Salesforce data model, sharing/security model, and how data quality and permission structures affect both functional and AI feature testing Working knowledge of SOQL/SOSL for test data validation and querying, and of integration testing across REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and middleware (e.g., Mule Soft) Hands-on experience testing AI-driven and agentic features, including: Designing test approaches for non-deterministic outputs: evaluation rubrics, golden datasets, regression suites for prompts/agent behavior, and acceptable-variance thresholds Testing Agent force agents, Copilot/Einstein-style features, and prompt-builder workflows for accuracy, grounding, hallucination risk, and adherence to business rules Evaluating AI outputs for bias, data privacy, and responsible-AI concerns, and partnering with stakeholders to define acceptance criteria for "good enough" AI behavior Using AI-assisted testing tools (e.g., AI-driven test case generation, self-healing test automation, AI code/PR review assistants) to increase test coverage and efficiency Monitoring AI feature performance and drift in production, and defining feedback loops for continuous evaluation Strong knowledge of test-driven and behavior-driven development practices, and ability to shape acceptance criteria before code is written Ability to write and review detailed test plans, test cases, and evaluation frameworks for complex system components, including AI agent/automation designs Ability to triage and drive resolution of complex defects across Apex, LWC, Flow, integrations, and AI/agentic behavior Strong research skills, including staying current on Salesforce release notes, Agentforce/AI feature rollouts, and emerging AI quality-assurance practices Knowledge of the broader sales technology tool stack (CPQ/Incentive Comp platforms, Gainsight, Monday.com) and how quality risk surfaces across integrated systems Ability to interface competently with developers, business analysts, product owners, and platform admins to finalize testable requirements Good oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain AI evaluation results, confidence levels, and residual risk to non-technical stakeholders. Work in a way that works for you We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, family leave and tuition reimbursement, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and long-term goals. Working flexible hours
- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive. Working for you At Elsevier, we know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer: Group Health Insurance Policy (covering self and family) Group Life insurance/accident policy Generous long-service awards New Baby gift Subsidized food provided (applies to India
- Chennai) Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, Gazetted Public Holiday and Maternity/Paternity Leave Free Transport provided to and from the office (applies to India
- Chennai) About Us A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1-855-833-5120. We believe that by working together with the communities we serve, we can shape human progress to go further, happen faster, and benefit all. We support continuous discovery and uphold the highest standards of content integrity, reliability, and reproducibility so the communities we serve can advance their field of science, healthcare or innovation with confidence. By combining high-quality content with powerful analytics, we transform complexity into clarity and deliver mission-critical insights that help professionals make better decisions when it matters most. We deliver insights that help research institutions, governments, and funders achieve their goals. We help researchers discover and share knowledge, collaborate, and accelerate innovation. We help librarians provide verified, quality information to universities. We help innovators turn knowledge into new products. We help health professionals improve patient care and educators train the next generation of doctors and nurses. Connecting quality content and innovative technologies, we make progress go further and happen faster. And by championing inclusion and sustainability, we ensure progress benefits all. With 9,500 employees, over 2,300 technologists in 5 major tech hubs, and more than 60 locations across the globe, we are committed to supporting the scientific and healthcare communities around the world. title: Senior Software Engineer — Salesforce
jobDescription:
Salesforce Software Engineer-III Do you enjoy driving the software strategy for complex software systems? About our Team:- Digital Business Solutions (DBS) delivers innovation and solves customer and business problems by leveraging the power of technology, data, and — increasingly — AI. We partner with sales and service stakeholders to deliver frictionless case management, self-service, and partner/customer-facing experiences, applying AI-driven automation — including Agent force and Einstein capabilities — where it measurably improves efficiency, personalization, and customer outcomes. We provide the expertise to understand business challenges and translate them into practical, scalable, and responsible solutions. About the

ROLE:
-
This position performs moderately difficult research, design, and software development assignments within the Salesforce ecosystem, with a focus on Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and AI-powered solutions (Agent force, Einstein, and related generative/predictive AI tooling). The position should have the ability to work on individual pieces of work and solve problems including the design of program flow for Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and integration logic, effective coding, and unit testing (Apex test classes, Jest for LWC).This position performs complex research, design, and software development assignments focused on the Salesforce Service Cloud and Experience Cloud platforms — with working exposure to adjacent Salesforce clouds (Sales Cloud, CPQ, Revenue Cloud) and integrated systems — and provides direct input to project plans, schedules, and methodology in the development of cross-functional solutions serving 2,000+ users. This position performs software design across Service Cloud (case management, omni-channel routing, knowledge, entitlements) and Experience Cloud (partner and customer portals, self-service sites) as well as integrated systems; mentors more-junior members of the team; leverages AI-assisted development tools and native Salesforce AI capabilities to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and enhance customer/partner-facing experiences; and talks to business users/stakeholders to translate their requests into scalable, compliant Salesforce solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Interface with business analysts, platform admins, and other technical team members to finalize requirements across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and the broader Salesforce ecosystem Write and review detailed technical specifications for complex system components, including custom Apex/LWC solutions, Experience Cloud site designs, and AI agent/automation designs Complete complex bug fixes across Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow automation, and third-party integrations Work closely with other development team members to understand complex product requirements and translate them into scalable Service Cloud and Experience Cloud architecture and software designs Successfully implement development processes, coding best practices, code reviews, and AI-assisted development standards (including responsible use, review, and validation of AI-generated code) Design, build, and govern AI-driven agents and automations within Service Cloud and Experience Cloud (e.g., Agentforce), ensuring outputs are accurate, secure, and aligned with business processes Operate in various development environments (Agile, Waterfall, etc.) while collaborating with key stakeholders across sales technology teams Resolve complex technical issues across Salesforce and adjacent platforms (Oracle Sales Cloud Incentive Comp, Gainsight, Monday.com) as necessary Train and onboard entry-level software engineers, ensuring they are knowledgeable in Salesforce development standards and AI-assisted tooling as directed by department management Keep abreast of new Salesforce platform releases, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud feature developments, and evolving AI development tooling Design and work with complex Salesforce data models supporting a 2,000+ user org, including performance and scalability considerations Mentor less-senior software developers on Salesforce development methodologies, optimization techniques, and effective/responsible use of AI development tools Ensure development work aligns with release management, packaging, and compliance/audit requirements All other duties as assigned. Requirements:- Advanced knowledge of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum, Waterfall) as applied to Salesforce release cycles and org governance Strong proficiency in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and data manipulation/optimization techniques (bulkification, governor-limit-aware design, asynchronous processing patterns) Deep working knowledge of Service Cloud: case management, Omni-Channel routing, queues and skills-based routing, entitlements and milestones, Knowledge, and (a plus) Service Cloud Voice/CTI integration Solid experience with Experience Cloud: LWR and Aura-based site building, community templates, sharing sets/rules, guest user security, and partner/customer self-service portal design Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling: standard/custom objects, normalized vs. denormalized structures, sharing/security models, and large data volume (LDV) design Strong knowledge of Salesforce data storage and integration subsystems (Salesforce Connect, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Mule Soft or equivalent middleware, external objects) Expertise in Salesforce development languages and frameworks: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura, Java Script, SOQL/SOSL, Flow/Flow Orchestrator, and integration via REST/SOAP APIs; working knowledge of Java/J2EE, HTML, XML, SQL, and .NET for integration and legacy system touchpoints Hands-on proficiency with AI-assisted development and AI-driven service/experience tooling — Agentforce/Einstein for service agents and experience personalization, AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Git Hub Copilot, Cursor) for Apex/LWC delivery, and evaluation of AI-generated code and outputs for security, compliance, and quality before production Strong research skills, including staying current on Salesforce release notes (three major releases/year), Service Cloud and Experience Cloud feature rollouts, and AI feature releases Strong knowledge of industry best practices in Salesforce development (Apex design patterns, trigger frameworks, CI/CD via tools like Copado, Gearset, or Salesforce DX/SFDX pipelines) Knowledge of the broader sales technology tool stack and how it integrates with Salesforce (CPQ/Incentive Comp platforms, Customer Success platforms like Gainsight, work management tools like Monday.com) Ability to interface competently with business analysts, admins, and other technical personnel to finalize title: Team Manager
jobDescription:
Team Manager Are you passionate about leading content operations and improving data quality for one of the world’s largest research databases? Do you enjoy working with cross-functional teams to solve complex content-flow challenges and drive continuous improvement through data and automation? About Our Team WDOT (WORKs Domain Operations Team), part of Elsevier’s Research Data Platform (RDP) organization, is responsible for the completeness, quality, and end-to-end content flow of Scopus, one of the world’s largest abstract and citation databases. The team manages the operational standards, thresholds, and governance frameworks that determine what content enters Scopus, how quickly it is processed, and how fully it is covered. This includes content ingestion, Articles-in-Press (Ai P) tracking, clustering and deduplication, citation correction, retractions, and content quality diagnostics. WDOT works closely with Content Sourcing (CSD), Publisher Relations (PRM), Source Data Management (SDM), and technology teams to keep Scopus complete, accurate, and trusted by the global research community. About the role As Team Manager, you will manage a team of Process/Data Specialists responsible for the completeness, quality, and end-to-end content flow of Scopus. You will oversee operational performance across completeness standards, ingestion and production pipelines, clustering, deduplication, and quality diagnostics, ensuring targets are met and risks are escalated and resolved. You will serve as the senior escalation point for cross-team issues, strengthen documentation and resilience to reduce single points of failure, and represent WDOT’s completeness and content-flow priorities in cross-domain governance forums.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead governance for Scopus completeness standards, quality benchmarks, and coverage-gap closure. Oversee content ingestion and production workflows to ensure timely and accurate content flow into Scopus. Manage exceptions and escalations for records that fail completeness or quality checks, working with Content, CSD, PRM, SDM, and technology teams. Review Power BI dashboards and reporting metrics to ensure completeness, speed, coverage, and quality insights are accurate and actionable. Ensure discard, retraction, correction, citation-accuracy, clustering, and deduplication processes are completed compliantly and on schedule. Lead, mentor, and develop Process/Data Specialists while setting clear goals, reviewing performance, and building an inclusive team culture. Act as the main escalation point for content-flow issues, Ai P delays, and completeness gaps requiring cross-functional support. Drive process improvement, resource planning, automation, AI-enabled data literacy, KPIs, and productivity initiatives for the completeness and content operations function. Proactive, assertive, and data-curious, with the confidence to surface issues early, challenge the status quo, make informed decisions with incomplete information, persist through pushback, escalate when needed, and use data to identify what the numbers may indicate next. Requirements: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in any discipline with 5+ years of relevant experience in content operations, data/content quality, or scholarly publishing. Strong understanding of bibliographic database completeness, content ingestion pipelines, metadata standards, and content-quality governance frameworks. Working knowledge of clustering, deduplication, retraction/correction, citation matching, and content ingestion or production workflows is preferred. Proficiency with Power BI or similar dashboarding tools to support metrics governance, reporting, and performance tracking. Understanding of AI technologies and data literacy to support automation, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement. Strong people leadership skills, with experience managing experienced individual contributors and guiding talent development. Ability to provide direction to stakeholders, peers, managers, and direct reports while ensuring clarity on priorities, goals, OKRs, and KPIs. Comfortable managing ambiguity, handling escalations, collaborating across functions, and partnering with senior management on strategy and execution planning. Work in a way that works for you We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals. Working flexible hours
- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive. Working for You We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer: Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents. Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company. Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones. Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement. Flexible Working Arrangement: work-life balance. Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges. Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority. Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support. Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment. New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood. Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates. Do you enjoy working with cross-functional teams to solve complex content-flow challenges and drive continuous improvement through data and automation? About Our Team WDOT (WORKs Domain Operations Team), part of Elsevier’s Research Data Platform (RDP) organization, is responsible for the completeness, quality, and end-to-end content flow of Scopus, one of the world’s largest abstract and citation databases. The team manages the operational standards, thresholds, and governance frameworks that determine what content enters Scopus, how quickly it is processed, and how fully it is covered. This includes content ingestion, Articles-in-Press (AiP) tracking, clustering and deduplication, citation correction, retractions, and content quality diagnostics. WDOT works closely with Content Sourcing (CSD), Publisher Relations (PRM), Source Data Management (SDM), and technology teams to keep Scopus complete, accurate, and trusted by the global research community. About the role As Team Manager, you will manage a team of Process/Data Specialists responsible for the completeness, quality, and end-to-end content flow of Scopus. You will oversee operational performance across completeness standards, ingestion and production pipelines, clustering, deduplication, and quality diagnostics, ensuring targets are met and risks are escalated and resolved. You will serve as the senior escalation point for cross-team issues, strengthen documentation and resilience to reduce single points of failure, and represent WDOT’s completeness and content-flow priorities in cross-domain governance forums. Responsibilities: Lead governance for Scopus completeness standards, quality benchmarks, and coverage-gap closure. Oversee content ingestion and production workflows to ensure timely and accurate content flow into Scopus. Manage exceptions and escalations for records that fail completeness or quality checks, working with Content, CSD, PRM, SDM, and technology teams. Review Power BI dashboards and reporting metrics to ensure completeness, speed, coverage, and quality insights are accurate and actionable. Ensure discard, retraction, correction, citation-accuracy, clustering, and deduplication processes are completed compliantly and on schedule. Lead, mentor, and develop Process/Data Specialists while setting clear goals, reviewing performance, and building an inclusive team culture. Act as the main escalation point for content-flow issues, AiP delays, and completeness gaps requiring cross-functional support. Drive process improvement, resource planning, automation, AI-enabled data literacy, KPIs, and productivity initiatives for the completeness and content operations function. Proactive, assertive, and data-curious, with the confidence to surface issues early, challenge the status quo, make informed decisions with incomplete information, persist through pushback, escalate when needed, and use data to identify what the numbers may indicate next. Requirements: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in any discipline with 5+ years of relevant experience in content operations, data/content quality, or scholarly publishing. Strong understanding of bibliographic database completeness, content ingestion pipelines, metadata standards, and content-quality governance frameworks. Working knowledge of clustering, deduplication, retraction/correction, citation matching, and content ingestion or production workflows is preferred. Proficiency with Power BI or similar dashboarding tools to support metrics governance, reporting, and performance tracking. Understanding of AI technologies and data literacy to support automation, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement. Strong people leadership skills, with experience managing experienced individual contributors and guiding talent development. Ability to provide direction to stakeholders, peers, managers, and direct reports while ensuring clarity on priorities, goals, OKRs, and KPIs. Comfortable managing ambiguity, handling escalations, collaborating across functions, and partnering with senior management on strategy and execution planning. Work in a way that works for you We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals. Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive. Working for You We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer: Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents. Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company. Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones. Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement. Flexible Working Arrangement: work-life balance. Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges. Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority. Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support. Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment. New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood. Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates. Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays. Free Transport pick up and drop from the home -office - home (applies in Chennai) About the Business A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals' advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world. We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location. We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1-855-833-5120. Criminals may pose as recruiters asking for money or personal information. We never request money or banking details from job applicants. Learn more about spotting and avoiding scams here. Please read our Candidate Privacy Policy. We are an equal opportunity employer: qualified applicants are considered for and treated during employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, protected veteran status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that by working together with the communities we serve, we can shape human progress to go further, happen faster, and benefit all. We support continuous discovery and uphold the highest standards of content integrity, reliability, and reproducibility so the communities we serve can advance their field of science, healthcare or innovation with confidence. By combining high-quality content with powerful analytics, we transform complexity into clarity and deliver mission-critical insights that help professionals make better decisions when it matters most. We deliver insights that help research institutions, governments, and funders achieve their goals. We help researchers discover and share knowledge, collaborate, and accelerate innovation. We help librarians provide verified, quality information to universities. We help innovators turn knowledge into new products. We help health professionals improve patient care and educators train the next generation of doctors and nurses. Connecting quality content and innovative technologies, we make progress go further and happen faster. And by championing inclusion and sustainability, we ensure progress benefits all. With 9,500 employees, over 2,300 technologists in 5 major tech hubs, and more than 60 locations across the globe, we are committed to supporting the scientific and healthcare communities around the world. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across technology, commercial, business, and early career jobs. If you are looking for a career that inspires progress in science, innovation and health, and allows you to grow every day, find your team at Elsevier. Elsevier is part of RELX Group. title: Senior Business Analyst
jobDescription:
Salesforce Senior Business Analyst. About our Team:- Digital Business Solutions (DBS) delivers innovation and solves customer and business problems by leveraging the power of technology, data, and — increasingly — AI. We partner with sales and service stakeholders to deliver frictionless case management, self-service, and partner/customer-facing experiences, applying AI-driven automation — including Agent force and Einstein capabilities — where it measurably improves efficiency, personalization, and customer outcomes. We provide the expertise to understand business challenges and translate them into practical, scalable, and responsible solutions. About the

ROLE:
-
This position performs moderately difficult research, design, and software development assignments within the Salesforce ecosystem, with a focus on Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and AI-powered solutions (Agent force, Einstein, and related generative/predictive AI tooling). The position should have the ability to work on individual pieces of work and solve problems including the design of program flow for Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and integration logic, effective coding, and unit testing (Apex test classes, Jest for LWC).

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Partner with business and product teams to document current business processes and challenges across Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, recommend process improvement, and design future-state processes Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation (e.g., Agent force, Einstein, Copilot-style tools, chatbots, and generative AI) to improve case resolution, self-service, and customer/employee experience Gather business requirements, high-level user stories, and acceptance criteria for Service Cloud and Experience Cloud enhancements, including AI-enabled features Maintain stakeholder expectations and raise appropriate issues to project managers as necessary Develop "trusted advisor" relationships with senior stakeholders through effective communication, including guiding them on the art of the possible with AI-enabled service solutions Work with technology teams to produce detailed user stories and acceptance criteria to support development and QA teams building on Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and related AI platforms Perform analysis on existing systems and support processes; identify options for potential solutions (including AI/automation options) and assess both technical and business suitability Support responsible AI adoption by helping evaluate data quality, process readiness, and change impact before AI features are introduced into service or self-service workflows. Requirements:- Proven experience in process modelling (BPMN standard), eliciting business requirements, and translating them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria Solid understanding of software development methodologies, platforms, and tools Hands-on experience with Salesforce Service Cloud (case management, omni-channel, knowledge) and Experience Cloud (portals/communities); familiarity with Salesforce AI capabilities (Einstein, Agent force, or similar) is highly desirable Demonstrated ability to plan and facilitate small to medium-sized workshops Strong verbal and written communication skills, enabling effective engagement across all organizational levels, including the production of high-quality process documentation Hands-on experience working in agile environments using recognized delivery frameworks such as Agile, Scrum, and Kanban Experience performing the Business Analyst role across the full software development lifecycle Experience with Lead-to-Cash or Customer Service processes and Salesforce; exposure to AI/automation initiatives within a CRM context is a plus Exposure to data analytics and data-driven decision-making, and familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Slack, Microsoft Office, and Microsoft Teams Curiosity and appetite for evaluating and piloting emerging AI tools and translating their potential into practical business value. Work in a way that works for you We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. title: 0926-IND-185 - Lead Data Analyst
jobDescription:
Team Lead, Scientific Discovery Platforms Lead a team of scientific experts responsible for ensuring the quality, discoverability, and customer relevance of search and API experiences across Reaxys, Embase, and future AI-enabled life sciences solutions. About our team:- We are a diverse, collaborative team combining Life Sciences, Data, Product, and Technology expertise. Our mission is to ensure scientific content is accurate, well organized, and trustworthy. We build AI-driven products people can rely on. We focus on data integrity, reliable insights, teamwork, and continuous learning across disciplines. About the

ROLE:
-
You will lead a team of 5-10 experienced Data Analysts supporting multiple Life Science solutions, including Reaxys and Embase. Our work operates at the intersection of scientific domain expertise, advanced data analysis, and the adoption of AI-enabled technologies.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Lead scientific subject matter experts (SMEs) evaluating Reaxys and Embase search and API quality. Improve discoverability through expert input on data models and pipelines. Oversee customer-focused quality assurance, testing, and feature releases. Escalate unexpected search and API changes with expert insight. jobDescription:
Subject Matter Expert – Data Curation (CSD) Are you passionate about improving data quality and ensuring trusted research records are accurate, complete, and easy to discover? Do you enjoy solving complex metadata, citation-linking, and content-curation challenges while working with cross-functional teams and technical tools? About Our Team The Customer Service Desk (CSD) function is part of Elsevier’s WDOT (WORKs Domain Operations Team) within the Research Data Platform (RDP) organization. CSD reviews and resolves valid content-related requests for Scopus, including missing content, metadata corrections, citation-link corrections, and retractions. The team ensures records are complete, accurate, and correctly linked. Operating through a two-tier support model (1LS/2LS), CSD works with content suppliers, Publisher Relations (PRM), Supplier Operations Manager (SOM), and Elsevier’s Ops Bank technical teams to maintain trusted Scopus records for the global research community. About the role As a Subject Matter Expert – Data Curation, you will provide deep technical expertise to resolve valid content-related requests impacting Scopus, including missing content, metadata corrections, citation-link corrections, and retractions. You will act as the 2LS expert and escalation point for complex curation cases, serving as the key authority on Ops Bank II, the Bulk Correction Portal, and BACCS tools used to correct records. You will ensure each case is curated accurately and within SLA, improve correction and curation processes, and strengthen the wider CSD/WDOT team’s data-curation capability through documentation and mentoring. Responsibilities Investigate and resolve escalated content-related requests, including missing content, data corrections, and non-Scopus or BDContent queries. Coordinate with content suppliers to obtain missing articles or issues and ensure delivery through OBII. Create and manage article-level and bulk metadata correction orders in Ops Bank II or through bulk scripts. Route invalid or out-of-scope queries to the right team and liaise with Elsevier technical teams on OBII and Scopus issues. Execute bulk metadata corrections using the Ops Bank II Bulk Correction Portal and resolve script or execution errors as per SOP. Perform citation-link corrections using BACCS, including force linking, force unlinking, and status checks. Maintain source-level updates and resolve bridge issues between VTW, OBII, and Scopus records. Ensure quality, SLA, KPI, reporting, process improvement, SOP documentation, and mentoring support for curation activities. Requirements: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information science, publishing, data management, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in content/data operations, scholarly publishing, or metadata curation. Hands-on experience with Ops Bank II/OBII, the Bulk Correction Portal, BACCS, or similar citation-linking tools. Strong knowledge of Scopus or similar bibliographic database structures, including articles, issues, source records, and citations. Expert-level experience in missing-content, metadata-correction, and citation-correction workflows. Ability to manage retraction handling and coordinate with CSD, PRM, SDM, and Ops Bank technical teams. Strong attention to detail, quality focus, and ability to manage SLA-bound deliverables and rework processes. Ability to triage complex escalations, document SOPs, improve processes, and communicate with suppliers and stakeholders. Work in a way that works for you We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals. Working flexible hours
- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive. title: Sr UX Designer II
jobDescription:
Sr UX Designer II Do you enjoy designing intuitive experiences for complex, data-rich enterprise platforms used by research communities worldwide? Do you thrive in fast-moving, collaborative environments where your design decisions shape tools relied upon by thousands of academic editors? About our Team:- Elsevier is a global leader in information and analytics, supporting researchers and healthcare professionals in advancing science and improving health outcomes. Our Digital Business Solutions (DBS) UX team works across a broad portfolio of research and editorial products, combining deep user empathy with rigorous design craft to build tools that genuinely serve the people who use them. The ERMS team is a cross-functional group of product, engineering and UX professionals based across the UK, Amsterdam, and India, and works closely with editorial stakeholders across Elsevier's journal portfolio. About the

ROLE:
-
As the Senior UX Designer you will be working on a number of key product areas; the main focus will be on the Editor Relationship Management System and its related Editor Portal, which are hosted on Salesforce and Salesforce Experience Cloud. You will own the design end-to-end, manage complex UX challenges, and deliver UI specifications. You will be an embedded member of the project team, collaborating closely with the Product Manager and development team throughout design, refinement, and build. You will also be supported by the wider DBS UX design team, who will help you onboard and provide design feedback throughout the engagement.We're looking for an exceptional designer who enjoys solving complex problems and creating elegant user experiences. You thrive in environments where not everything is fully defined. Rather than waiting for answers, you're naturally curious, ask thoughtful questions, and work collaboratively to create clarity. Just as importantly, you're someone people enjoy working with. You have a low-ego, highly collaborative mindset. You believe the best products are built together. You share your work early, actively seek feedback, challenge ideas and are just as happy seeing someone else's idea succeed as your own. Collaboration isn't something you do; it's simply how you work.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Collaborate closely with the entire project team — Product, Engineering, and stakeholders — to develop a comprehensive understanding of the project scope, infrastructure, and user needs. Review existing provision and develop new consolidated information architecture and flows based on core user tasks; user testing and iterating with regular user feedback. Understand and map current editorial workflows, identify pain points, and design solutions that improve usability and support smoother workflow transitions. Create design thinking and user understanding documents that demonstrate how existing functionality will be extended and mapped to meet user needs — transforming initial concepts into ready-to-ship features. Produce UX design and information architecture that meet the needs of the key user groups, working within the Elsevier design system. Build prototypes and define key user flows for testing and feedback, managing fast iterations based on regular user input. Define the portal’s look and feel using Elsevier design libraries and existing patterns, creating new components and patterns where needed. Develop a strategy for migrating existing workflows to the new system as part of a continuous delivery approach. Measure user feedback post-launch and work with the Product Manager to scope and plan for future phases. Requirements:- A portfolio demonstrating design experience covering User Research, UX, and UI design, with 12-15 years of experience in enterprise systems. Proven experience in front-end UX/UI design for complex, data-rich platforms; experience with academic, editorial, or similar professional user groups is a bonus. Experience wire-framing, prototyping, and creating detailed, customer-focused designs, including knowledge of customer journey mapping techniques. High proficiency in Figma (Figma Make + AI approaches to design & development): able to produce polished UX flows, design concepts, high-fidelity designs, and interactive prototypes. Excellent working knowledge of accessibility guidelines (WCAG) and demonstrable ability to produce WCAG 2.2 AA-compliant designs. Strong skills in user research and user testing, with hands-on experience running sessions and incorporating feedback into design iterations. Ability to interpret user analytics and research data, adopting a data-driven approach to creative problem-solving. Comfortable with both tactical and strategic UX work — able to zoom in on interaction detail and zoom out to consider broader information architecture and system design. Experience applying an incremental product design process in an Agile environment. Experience using and contributing to pattern libraries and design systems (experience with the Graphene design system or Salesforce Experience Cloud is advantageous). Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to articulate design concepts to a range of audiences and communicate persuasively at a strategic level. Ability to work collaboratively with diverse, global, cross-functional and cross-cultural teams. Enthusiasm for joining a collaborative UX team with a human-centred approach. Good to have Experience designing AI-powered products or AI-assisted workflows. Experience using AI in your design process, such as rapid prototyping, vibe coding, Spec-Driven Development (SDD), or similar approaches. Experience contributing to design systems. sourceDescription: Sr UX Designer II Do you enjoy designing intuitive experiences for complex, data-rich enterprise platforms used by research communities worldwide? Do you thrive in fast-moving, collaborative environments where your design decisions shape tools relied upon by thousands of academic editors? About our Team:- Elsevier is a global leader in information and analytics, supporting researchers and healthcare professionals in advancing science and improving health outcomes. Our Digital Business Solutions (DBS) UX team works across a broad portfolio of research and editorial products, combining deep user empathy with rigorous design craft to build tools that genuinely serve the people who use them. The ERMS team is a cross-functional group of product, engineering and UX professionals based across the UK, Amsterdam, and India, and works closely with editorial stakeholders across Elsevier's journal portfolio. About the Role:- As the Senior UX Designer you will be working on a number of key product areas; the main focus will be on the Editor Relationship Management System and its related Editor Portal, which are hosted on Salesforce and Salesforce Experience Cloud. You will own the design end-to-end, manage complex UX challenges, and deliver UI specifications. You will be an embedded member of the project team, collaborating closely with the Product Manager and development team throughout design, refinement, and build. You will also be supported by the wider DBS UX design team, who will help you onboard and provide design feedback throughout the engagement.We're looking for an exceptional designer who enjoys solving complex problems and creating elegant user experiences. You thrive in environments where not everything is fully defined. Rather than waiting for answers, you're naturally curious, ask thoughtful questions, and work collaboratively to create clarity. Just as importantly, you're someone people enjoy working with. You have a low-ego, highly collaborative mindset. You believe the best products are built together. You share your work early, actively seek feedback, challenge ideas and are just as happy seeing someone else's idea succeed as your own. Collaboration isn't something you do; it's simply how you work. Responsibilities:- Collaborate closely with the entire project team — Product, Engineering, and stakeholders — to develop a comprehensive understanding of the project scope, infrastructure, and user needs. Review existing provision and develop new consolidated information architecture and flows based on core user tasks; user testing and iterating with regular user feedback. Understand and map current editorial workflows, identify pain points, and design solutions that improve usability and support smoother workflow transitions. Create design thinking and user understanding documents that demonstrate how existing functionality will be extended and mapped to meet user needs — transforming initial concepts into ready-to-ship features. Produce UX design and information architecture that meet the needs of the key user groups, working within the Elsevier design system. Build prototypes and define key user flows for testing and feedback, managing fast iterations based on regular user input. Define the portal’s look and feel using Elsevier design libraries and existing patterns, creating new components and patterns where needed. Develop a strategy for migrating existing workflows to the new system as part of a continuous delivery approach. Measure user feedback post-launch and work with the Product Manager to scope and plan for future phases. Requirements:- A portfolio demonstrating design experience covering User Research, UX, and UI design, with 12-15 years of experience in enterprise systems. Proven experience in front-end UX/UI design for complex, data-rich platforms; experience with academic, editorial, or similar professional user groups is a bonus. Experience wire-framing, prototyping, and creating detailed, customer-focused designs, including knowledge of customer journey mapping techniques. High proficiency in Figma (Figma Make + AI approaches to design & development): able to produce polished UX flows, design concepts, high-fidelity designs, and interactive prototypes. Excellent working knowledge of accessibility guidelines (WCAG) and demonstrable ability to produce WCAG 2.2 AA-compliant designs. Strong skills in user research and user testing, with hands-on experience running sessions and incorporating feedback into design iterations. Ability to interpret user analytics and research data, adopting a data-driven approach to creative problem-solving. Comfortable with both tactical and strategic UX work — able to zoom in on interaction detail and zoom out to consider broader information architecture and system design. Experience applying an incremental product design process in an Agile environment. Experience using and contributing to pattern libraries and design systems (experience with the Graphene design system or Salesforce Experience Cloud is advantageous). Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to articulate design concepts to a range of audiences and communicate persuasively at a strategic level. Ability to work collaboratively with diverse, global, cross-functional and cross-cultural teams. Enthusiasm for joining a collaborative UX team with a human-centred approach. Good to have Experience designing AI-powered products or AI-assisted workflows. Experience using AI in your design process, such as rapid prototyping, vibe coding, Spec-Driven Development (SDD), or similar approaches. Experience contributing to design systems. title: Scientific Illustrator
jobDescription:
Scientific Illustrator Are you passionate about transforming complex scientific concepts into compelling visual stories that support world-class research communication? Do you enjoy combining illustration, design, and scientific understanding to create impactful visuals for a global scientific community? About our Team Our STMJ (Science, Technology, and Medical Journals) team, including our prestigious Cell Press portfolio, publishes high-quality, peer-reviewed research that drives progress across scientific and medical disciplines. We work closely with authors, editors, reviewers, and societies to ensure the integrity, relevance, and impact of the published work. Through innovation in editorial workflows and publishing technology, we empower global research communities to discover, evaluate, and share knowledge that advances science and improves lives. About the Role The Scientific Illustrator is responsible for the illustrative print and online content that appears in the front section of the flagship journal Cell, occasional covers for the research and review journal portfolio, review of outsourced illustration and design work, and production of website and marketing collateral. The day-to-day work primarily focuses on the creation of vector-based figures in Adobe Illustrator. The Scientific Illustrator is responsible for creating figure drafts, communicating with both editorial staff and external authors to refine the drafts, and delivering the final figures to our production team. Other tasks may include creating cover designs for journals using Adobe Photoshop, editing photographs, reviewing external illustration work, and providing design or web content support for other teams. This role is also responsible for independently managing frequent and demanding journal deadlines and schedules as well as proactively anticipating and troubleshooting illustration issues/problems. Cell Press leads with quality, high standards, strong relationships, and exceptional author service, and the Scientific Illustrator will be expected to demonstrate those values in their work. The Scientific illustrator will report to the Illustration and Design Program Manager and work closely with the Senior Illustrator, who will oversee and assign day-to-day projects. Responsibilities Conceptualize and create illustrations from authors’ rough sketches or electronic files Create ideas for illustrations where the author of an article has not provided suggestions Assist with management of freelance illustration model and perform quality control on freelanced art and design work Research and license photographic images when appropriate Liaise with Cell Press editors, authors, and suppliers Attend outside seminars and lectures on industry trends and stay informed on design innovations Think creatively about new ideas and features Contribute to the creation of visual assets that accurately communicate scientific information Requirements Mastery of Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop, with familiarity in Adobe In Design Strong visual and graphic design skills with the ability to transform complex scientific information into clear and cohesive figures Broad scientific literacy and the ability to quickly understand new scientific concepts across disciplines Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer service-focused outlook Ability to complete work independently, manage timelines, solve problems, and follow through on commitments Ability to prioritize, organize, and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines Ability to adapt to established visual styles and strict formatting requirements Strong attention to detail and commitment to scientific accuracy Candidates must have a portfolio that demonstrates the above skills, especially focusing on mastery of Adobe Illustrator and design/layout examples. Qualified candidates will be expected to demonstrate their ability by taking a design test. Work in a Way That Works for You We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. title: Senior Account Manager - eProducts
jobDescription:
Senior Account Manager – e Product Renewals Are you a strategic renewals professional who excels at navigating complex negotiations and building trusted executive relationships? Do you enjoy turning customer value into long-term partnerships while influencing commercial strategy and mentoring others? About Our Team Elsevier Health serves nurses, physicians, pharmacists, allied health professionals, and health system executives, embedding evidence-based content into the care process to improve patient outcomes. Our solutions span clinical decision support, drug information, patient engagement, health professions education and certification, and analytics. jobDescription:
Commercial Product Manager Would you like to build products to delight our customers? Can you use a data-driven approach to uncover information and opportunities? About our Team Lexis Nexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case. About the Role The Commercial Product Manager will own one or more product/solution and lead commercial rollout and product lifecycle in-market. He/she will own product development plans and represent their feature(s) within the cross-functional team proposing new feature ideas that address a customer pain point or need based on his/her deep and first hand understanding of the customer. He/she will prioritize and communicate customer issues based on relevant data for timely resolution and also lead the demo/product showcase to key stakeholders at program milestones. The Product Manager is key person involved in Go To Market strategy and execution, working alongside Sales and Marketing driving business growth. Responsibilities Customer Focus Interacts frequently with customers, and generates customer requirements. Anticipates customer needs and prioritizes those for the organization. Understands how his/her role impacts customer satisfaction. Analyzes and interprets what is happening in the market, driven by the latest news and trends, particularly competitive announcements and events. Predicts short term market changes and implications on the product. Continuously aims to meet customer expectations without compromising commercial viability and quality of the product. Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis Actively gathers data from multiple sources (customer, market analysis, sales and revenue, etc.) to drive solutions to business problems and issues of consequence to the company. Demonstrates the ability to make trade off decisions between potential product capabilities. Evaluates product hypotheses in a quantitative manner, including AB testing for interactive products. Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention. Generates new ideas by analyzing product data for insights. Go to Market & Product Marketing Lifecycle Supports the go to market strategy with good communication of customer requirements and timelines to stakeholders Assists on product rollout launch plans through coordinated development with external customer facing teams such as marketing and sales. Answers sales and customer questions regarding feature function, pricing, packaging, value proposition and competition. Offers enablement sessions and provide materials in support of operations for market rollout, for Sales and customer facing teams Outlines key milestones, outcomes and deliverables during go-to-market and product strategy planning. Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle Solves customer issues with product and content aligned with business goals Has a deep understanding of product features, value proposition, customer Use Cases; able to develop User story, prototypes and test hypotheses Lead product discovery, according to defined process, for new product and feature development. Manages end to end product lifecycle, provide periodic review and analysis of product performance, and recommendation for investment and divestment Strategy & Commercial Acumen Determines strategic product vision and priorities for a feature area, and shapes/champions future product direction. Independently uses information derived from competitive analysis to drive product direction and strategy. Understands, formulates and budgets the operating costs required to deliver the revenues Creates product development plans including opportunity assessment and business case. Technical Skills Considers high-level technical approaches to use when prioritizing functionality. Is proficient with technologies and AI Has a firm grasp of data, technical principles and best practices of product management Requirements Show a customer-centric focus when creating solutions Minimum Years of PM Experience: 4 years Able to collaborate with cross-functional teams to create, and rollout successful products to customers Have great experience working as a Product Lead, delivering enhancements and innovation to customers contributing to business growth Have excellent communication skills and the ability to present complex information to a variety of audiences Have a proficient background in various technologies including Microsoft suites, Power BI, data analytics tools and AI tools Bachelors degree in commercial discipline ( Product, Marketing, Business, Law). MBA is preferred. Work in a way that works for you We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive Working for you We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. Software Engineer II Are you an experienced Salesforce developer with a ‘can do’ attitude and enthusiasm that inspires others? And are you eager to work on delivering high quality products to our customers? About our Team:- The team is responsible for technically supporting editorial relationships and licenses for secondary content. The team themselves are highly collaborative and supportive, with the role having the ability to grow. About the

ROLE:
-
The Salesforce developer engages directly with global, multi-functional teams to provide user support and assist in strategic development and enhancement of the Customer Relationship Management application (Salesforce). This includes, but is not limited to, direct user engagement and support, key stakeholder support and business analysis, continual business process improvement, assessment and advancement of complementary Salesforce technologies, and alignment to overarching Sales & Marketing business objectives.The Salesforce developer acts as the business-facing Subject Matter Expert for the Salesforce technology stack; primary responsibilities include real-time user support, end-user documentation, assistance in capturing and evaluating business requirements, stakeholder support during UAT and various phases of the development lifecycle, and execution of required development throughout phased implementation. jobDescription:
Are you an experienced localization professional who is curious, proactive and excited by new ways of working? Would you like to help us evolve how we manage multilingual quality and terminology across content, workflows and AI-enabled solutions? About our Team:- GLo SS (Global Localization Solutions & Services) is Elsevier's central localization technology and expertise service. We deliver shared infrastructure, AI-powered translation tools, linguistic data assets, and localization expertise to teams across the business, from Journal Operations and Clinical Solutions to Marketing and Product. Launched in 2021, we've grown rapidly and work in a matrixed environment with stakeholders across functions and geographies. We are part of Operations and sit within the AI and Knowledge Operations department. Our team is small, high-impact, and globally distributed. This role is based in India and reports to the Localization Solutions Manager in Amsterdam. About the

ROLE:
-
As Multilingual Quality & Terminology Specialist, you will own the day-to-day execution of two closely related capability streams: multilingual AI quality evaluation and terminology management. Working alongside capability leads and cross-functional partners across product, content, Gen AI Evaluation, and Data Science, you will run evaluations, maintain terminology infrastructure, coordinate reviewer networks, and turn results into clear, actionable recommendations.Terminology and language quality are increasingly recognized across Elsevier as critical infrastructure for AI: the data layer that makes AI outputs trustworthy, consistent, and defensible. You will play a direct role in building and scaling these capabilities across the business. This is a new kind of role, in a space where new approaches are developing fast. The right candidate brings solid localization expertise, genuine curiosity about AI, and the confidence to build in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

- Run multilingual AI quality evaluations across translation tools, models, and use cases, producing insights that inform product and localization decisions Coordinate and manage reviewer networks for evaluation and terminology programs Build and maintain terminology infrastructure: term bases, style guides, and multilingual language assets across Elsevier domains, including governance processes and stakeholder-specific terminology structures Prepare and present quality readouts for AI product and localization teams, translating evaluation findings into clear, actionable recommendations Onboard and support stakeholders on evaluation methodologies and terminology processes Collaborate with Gen AI Evaluation, AI product, platform, and content teams to integrate quality and terminology into shared workflows Work effectively across a globally distributed, matrixed organization with stakeholders at varying levels of technical and linguistic expertise Requirements:- Background in localization, language technology, or NLP/AI with a strong language focus Solid understanding of terminology management, with hands-on experience building or maintaining term bases or style guides Solid grounding in translation quality evaluation concepts and metrics; hands-on experience with LLM evaluation or MT benchmarking is a strong plus Genuine curiosity about AI and what it means for multilingual quality: you follow the space and are eager to develop hands-on experience Comfortable working with structured data, AI tools, and technical workflows; willing to learn new tools and approaches as the technology evolves Strong coordination and collaboration skills, comfortable working across teams, disciplines, and time zones Clear communicator in English, able to translate technical findings for non-technical audiences Comfortable with ambiguity: you take ownership, bring your own ideas, and develop your thinking rather than waiting for direction Eager to grow in a fast-moving field where the best practices are still being defined{Empty} Work in a way that works for you:

Are you a highly visible champion with a ‘can do’ attitude and enthusiasm that inspires others? About our Team:- Our global team supports products in education and electronic health records that introduce students to digital charting and prepare them to document care in today’s modern clinical environment. We have a very stable product that we continuously strive to improve. Our team values trust, respect, collaboration, agility, and quality. About the

ROLE:
This position is a subject matter expert on broad technologies and sets the architectural standard for the workgroup. The position executes corporate tactical technology strategy on large multifunctional development activities, solves complex technical problems, writes complex code for computer systems, and serves as a senior source of expertise. This position is expected to be seen as a “go to” person across the division for a set of technologies.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- • Perform reviews to ensure enterprise and architectural standards and processes are followed. • Write advanced complex code for computer systems and serve as a senior source of expertise. • Manage system and user acceptance testing cycles to ensure accurate and quality business solutions. • Lead the development of technical standards, and perform reviews to ensure enterprise and architectural standards and processes are followed. • Serve as a primary technical point of contact for external technology resources. • Act as a technology mentor to other engineers. • Recommend technical strategy and direction across functional area. • Participate in development and evolution of architecture. • Consult with stakeholders to find alternative work-arounds during system outages. • Provide design input across a product. • Work directly with customers and end users. • Serve as acknowledged “go to” person on coding and technical issues. • Interface with other technical personnel or team members to finalize requirements. • Write and review portions of detailed specifications for the development of system components of moderate complexity. • Complete complex bug fixes. • Design and work with complex data models. • Mentor lead software developers on consultancy path on development methodologies and optimization techniques. • Seek diverse ideas and perspectives from a variety of sources to create better solutions, products, and services. • All other duties as assigned. Requirements:- 12+ years of Software Engineering experience • BS Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience required; advanced degree preferred • Industrywide or broad companywide technical knowledge. • Specialized coding skills. • Knowledge of large complex systems. • Proven ability to adapt to new roles and responsibilities. • Software development process expert in applicable methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall). • Expertise in data modeling, design and manipulation, optimization, best practices, tuning, and leading industry trend knowledge. • Expertise in normalized/dimensional data modeling principles and their application to complex business needs. • Expertise in industry technology language development trends. • Strong knowledge of architectural principles. • Proven expertise and experience applying industry best practices in all aspects of development. • Expertise in test-driven development and maintenance including techniques for applying best practices for overall project benefit. • Expert knowledge of multiple data storage subsystems. • Budgeting and finance. • Research skills. • Proven expertise in the use and development of applicable desktop tool sets. • Proven expert in partnering and leading internal and external technology resources in solving complex business needs. • Strong experience with various resource models such as Managed Services and/or Staff Augmentation. • Test-driven development. • Strong proficiency with data manipulation language including optimization techniques. • Ability to design and work with complex data models. • Expertise in development languages including but not limited to: Java/J2EE, Java Script, JSP, C/C++, HTML, XML, SQL, Windows, UNIX, and .Net. • Knowledge in using and developing applicable tool sets. • Ability to write and review portions of detailed specifications for the development of system components of advanced complexity. • Strong organization/project planning, time management, and change management skills across multiple functional groups and departments, and strong delegation skills involving prioritizing and reprioritizing projects and managing projects of various size and complexity. • Advanced problem-solving experience involving leading teams in identifying, researching, and coordinating the resources necessary to effectively troubleshoot/diagnose complex project issues; prior success extracting/translating findings into alternatives/solutions; and identifying risks/impacts and schedule adjustments to facilitate management decision-making. • Advanced communication (verbal and written) and customer service skills. Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills applicable to a wide audience including senior and executive management, customers, etc., including diction/terminology and presenting information in a concise and effective manner to clients, management, and various departments using assorted communication mediums. - We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive. Working for you:
- At Elsevier, we know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. jobDescription:

Are you passionate about architecting scalable test automation solutions using modern web technologies like Playwright and Selenium? Join Us:- Are you ready to help us progress science and health? This position is for a senior individual contributor who combines strong manual testing expertise with significant programming skills to deliver test planning, manual testing and automated testing coverage using Java Script, Type Script, Playwright, and Selenium. This role ensures the on-time delivery of high-quality software products through hands-on test planning, execution, deep technical problem-solving and rigorous quality practices. As a senior member of the QE team, this role sets a high technical bar through the quality and depth of their own work and provides guidance to other engineers when needed, without formal management or team-leadership responsibilities.

- Creating detailed test plans and test strategies for features and releases, identifying appropriate scope and risk areas across manual and automated testing. Designing and executing manual testing for complex features where automation is not feasible or not yet in place, ensuring thorough coverage of functional and edge-case scenarios. Developing and maintaining automated end-to-end (E2E) test scripts using Playwright and Selenium, applying strong programming skills to build reliable, maintainable test code. Building and enhancing automated solutions for functional and non-functional testing, using existing tooling and frameworks and proposing improvements where gaps exist. Investigating Production issues & incidents, performing root-cause analysis, and documenting findings to support resolution and prevention. Collaborating closely with Development and Operations teams throughout the SDLC to ensure products meet requirements and quality standards, with tests integrated into CI/CD pipelines. Sharing testing knowledge and best practices with peers, and providing guidance to less experienced engineers when needed, without formal mentoring or management responsibilities. Continuously improving personal testing practices and contributing ideas for improving team-wide test processes and frameworks. Requirements:- 8+ years of test automation engineering experience, with deep expertise in Software Developer in Test (SDET) roles and a track record of technical leadership. BS in Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience required; advanced degree a plus. Expert-level proficiency in Java Script and Type Script for designing and building scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks. Deep expertise in Playwright and Selenium for E2E testing, including cross-browser automation, API testing, and framework architecture. Strong command of QA methodologies, including BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) with tools like Cucumber. Proven experience designing and implementing performance testing strategies, with strong expertise integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Git Hub Actions, Jenkins). Demonstrated ability to lead continuous improvement initiatives in test frameworks and processes, with measurable impact across teams. Experience mentoring and coaching junior and mid-level engineers. Excellent oral and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across multiple agile teams.
